header: An image with a numbered legend
lead: Each entry explains one numbered spot in a sentence. Draw the numbers into the image itself; the legend follows their order.
caption: Swap in a screenshot with the numbers drawn on it — this fixture photo has none.

callouts.title: Numbers live in the image
callouts.text: A marker laid over a responsive image is right at one screen width only, so the artwork carries the numbers.

callouts.title: The legend is an ordered list
callouts.text: Screen readers announce the order without having to see the numbered squares.

callouts.title: Reverse swaps the sides
callouts.text: The image moves to the other side. The order in the HTML stays the same.

callouts.title: The image takes the wider column
callouts.text: Three parts to two, so the numbers in the picture stay readable.

image.alternative: A small fenced electrical substation in front of green hills.
